note: Bundled 'Vad är nytt' changelog. MAINTAINERS: every release PR that bumps versionCode/versionName in app/build.gradle.kts MUST append a new entry here (newest first): versionCode, versionName, releaseDate (ISO yyyy-MM-dd), highlights (max ~3 short user-facing Swedish lines shown in the update popup) and changes (full bulleted list shown on the 'Vad är nytt' page). Keep descriptions user-facing Swedish — no internal jargon. See apps/android/README.md § Changelog.
